chunks.text:
[Intro]
{dread at the summit: a deep tolling bell and timpani roll, a vast organ swell, the lead slowly booms the theme's first notes in minor, then snaps into the drive}
positive_styles: A minor turning to A major
layered pulse-wave lead booming a noble minor melody
solemn pipe organ and warm reverbed string chords
full driving drums with timpani rolls and crash cymbals
tragic, grave and courageous, sorrow and resolve
sense of standing before something vast

chunks.text:
[Main Theme]
{the noble minor melody boomed on the layered lead over driving bass and drums, a rising leap then a sorrowful stepwise fall, grave and unforgettable}
positive_styles: A minor turning to A major
layered pulse-wave lead booming a noble minor melody
solemn pipe organ and warm reverbed string chords
full driving drums with timpani rolls and crash cymbals
tragic, grave and courageous, sorrow and resolve

chunks.text:
[Main Theme Reprise]
{the melody again with the second lead answering each phrase and organ chords filling out, drums pounding harder}
positive_styles: A minor turning to A major
layered pulse-wave lead booming a noble minor melody
solemn pipe organ and warm reverbed string chords
full driving drums with timpani rolls and crash cymbals
tragic, grave and courageous, sorrow and resolve

chunks.text:
[Bridge]
{contrast: the clouds break, the harmony turns to radiant A major, the same melody rising triumphant with a bright harp sweep and crash cymbal, a promise of dawn, then darkening back toward the minor}
positive_styles: A minor turning to A major
layered pulse-wave lead booming a noble minor melody
solemn pipe organ and warm reverbed string chords

tragic, grave and courageous, sorrow and resolve

chunks.text:
[Main Theme Return]
{the minor melody returns grave and driving; the last bar drives on the dominant straight back into the main theme, no ending}
positive_styles: A minor turning to A major
